text:
Lina K: quick q — switching from part-time to full-time effective 2025-06-01. Do I become 401(k) eligible right away or is there a waiting period? Also if I enroll in HSA mid-year do limits prorate? And will employer match be prorated for earlier part-time pay? cc @Chris P

Chris P: congrats! Our plan uses status + service. There's a 1-month service rule for auto-enroll but you can opt in immediately by submitting the benefits-change form. If you want deferrals to start on the first paycheck after 6/1 submit before payroll cutoff (I'll DM cutoff).

Sam P: TL;DR: match is per-paycheck on deferrals so only paychecks where you defer get matched. No retroactive quarter proration. HSA contribution limits are annual IRS limits; the plan itself doesn't prorate the legal max. If you enroll mid-year you can still hit the full annual limit but watch IRS last-month rule.

Jill (Benefits): vendor notes: HSA eligibility follows first-of-month rules. Example: change to family HDHP 6/1 => eligible 6/1. Employer HSA deductions start on the payroll after enrollment. You can enter a monthly amount or a target amount on ADP — payroll won't auto-stop at IRS limits unless you set a target or end date. Catch-up (55+) is separate and not prorated.

Lina K: what about vesting? I show 50% vested now. Does switching to FT reset schedule?

Sam P: nope — vesting is based on service accrual and your existing vesting stays. Status change doesn't reset prior service.

Lina K: if I set monthly HSA that reaches annual max before Dec will payroll stop?

Payroll Bot: payroll does not auto-stop contributions based on IRS limits unless you set a target or an end date in the benefits-change form. Recommended: calculate monthly = (remaining_allowance / remaining_months) or use a target amount and payroll will stop when reached. Ping payroll if you want monitoring.

Chris P: action items for Lina: fill https://redwood.company/adp/forms/benefits-change choose "Status change", set 401k % and HSA monthly or target. Payroll cutoff for June is 2025-05-23 17:00 PT for first June paycheck. If you miss it contributions start on next payroll. I'll DM the cutoff calendar and confirm once submitted. :thumbsup:
